Class ViewAddExperienceInformation

java.lang.Object
guiAddExperienceInformation.ViewAddExperienceInformation
public class ViewAddExperienceInformation extends Object

Title: ViewAddExperienceInformation Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Add Experience Information Page. This class provides the JavaFX GUI widgets that enable a user to input experience information, what was done to leverage a lesson learned, how it was done, how much time it took, and the effort from team members, and add it to an existing lesson.

  • Constructor Details

    • ViewAddExperienceInformation

      private ViewAddExperienceInformation()

      Method: ViewCreateLesson()

      Description: This method initializes all the elements of the graphical user interface. This method determines the location, size, font, color, and change and event handlers for each GUI object.

      This is a singleton and is only performed once. Subsequent uses fill in the changeable fields using the displayRole2Home method.

  • Method Details

    • displayAddExperienceInformation

      public static void displayAddExperienceInformation(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: displayCreateLesson(Stage ps, User user, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: This method is the single entry point from outside this package to cause the Add Experience Information page to be displayed. It first sets up every shared attributes so we don't have to pass parameters. It then checks to see if the page has been setup. If not, it instantiates the class, initializes all the static aspects of the GUI widgets (e.g., location on the page, font, size, and any methods to be performed). After the instantiation, the code then populates the elements that change based on the user and the system's current state. It then sets the Scene onto the stage, and makes it visible to the user. Lastly, sets the title for the window, displays the page, and waits for the user to do something.

      Parameters:
      ps - specifies the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and it's methods
      user - specifies the User for this GUI and its methods
      lesson - specifies the LessonLearned for this GUI and its methods
